# AI Economy

> Helping businesses simplify the complex and focus on what works in the AI era.

AI Economy is a global AI strategy, training and tools platform founded by Sarah Balmer. We help business leaders, teams and enterprises discover where AI creates commercial impact, build the skills to use it, and deploy it responsibly.

## Products & Services

- **Priority AI** – AI Readiness Diagnostic that maps opportunity, fluency and change readiness by department, returning a prioritised action plan.
- **Sarah Speaks** – Practical AI training for business leaders and teams. Self-paced, jargon-free courses that deliver skills you can use on Monday morning.
- **Agent Alice** – Marketing & Content AI Agent powered by 25+ years of strategic marketing expertise. Repurposes content, generates campaigns, and optimises for GEO.
- **AI Consultancy** – Bespoke AI strategy consulting. Executive workshops, governance frameworks, and commercial roadmaps for enterprises.
- **AI Toolkit** – Curated directory of 50+ tested AI tools across writing, coding, image, video, research and audio categories. Updated weekly.
- **Gatha** – Personal knowledge dashboard that aggregates newsletters, links and articles into a visual wall, then generates daily briefs and personalised podcasts.

## Founder

Sarah Balmer – AI strategist, educator and entrepreneur. Former corporate leader turned AI economist. Based globally, serving clients across Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific.

## Mission

To make AI practical, accessible and commercially impactful for every business – from solo operators to global enterprises.
